PRD posted below for city review. This is the canonical document for the clean Warrior Path AI build (Candidate, HQ, Field Assessor only). Monday.com = source of truth. Presidio intercepts ALL candidate data before LLMs. Full Ralph Wiggum multi-model QC enforced on every step. No recruiter view. Detailed PRD:

**PRD: Warrior Path AI – Candidate Intelligence Platform**

**Vision**: Secure multi-model AI system evaluating candidates using Monday.com as single source of truth, with Microsoft Presidio intercepting all candidate data before any LLM, delivering assessments to Candidate, HQ, and Field Assessor only.

**Core Principles**:
- Monday.com = Source of Truth for all data, status, scores.
- Presidio Firewall: All candidate data anonymized BEFORE reaching any LLM.
- Views: Candidate (self-service), HQ (oversight/analytics), Field Assessor (mobile evaluation) — NO recruiter view.
- Warrior Path Rules: Every change uses factory crucible (5 divergent models → review → deliberation → adversarial QC). Persistent memory from 350+ sessions injected on every call.
- Zero Hallucination: All outputs traceable to Monday.com + Presidio + peer QC signatures.

**User Roles & Views** (see full details in previous post or factory run).

**Architecture**: Nx monorepo (warrior-core, warrior-frontend, warrior-backend). Presidio → warrior-core (multi-model + QC) → Monday.com → UIs.

Full detailed PRD available in session history / crucible artifacts. Ready for 5-model adversarial review and factory execution. --type position
